mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, price, suitable_people, items, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM appointment_package WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, name, description, price, suitable_people, items, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM appointment_package WHERE status = 'ENABLED' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, name, description, price, suitable_people, items, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM appointment_package WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, name, description, price, suitable_people, items, status, create_time, update_time, deleted FROM appointment_package WHERE deleted = 0 AND name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%') ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO appointment_package (name, description, price, suitable_people, items, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{suitablePeople}, #{items}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_package SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
